policy.ball: fixed collinear court-plane origin, landing and receiving point; constant ground direction and speed through bounce; separate authored height curve with one bounce and net clearance; speed multiplied by 0.9; serve 1.111s / return 1.222s, no homing or force/collision simulation
policy.agent: local rule policy: incoming destination, legal movement and shot request; no external model
policy.input: arrows move; J forehand K backhand; S serve; Space pause; R reset
policy.ground: player translation for controls; sprite root anchored on fixed court
policy.ball_templates: same actor/sequence or actor/action supplies lateral direction and reference only; stored curves are unused
policy.contact: fixed receiving region and deadline, legal animation may accelerate up to 6 ticks per game tick; miss if unavailable; no measured racket collision
